en: The Non-root-with-root Dyad, the Wholesome Triad.

Dependent on a rootless, with-root condition, wholesome state, there arises a state that is neither root nor with-root and is not wholesome, by way of root condition. Under root [condition] there is one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there is one.

Dependent on a rootless, with-root, unwholesome state, there arises a state that is neither root nor with-root and is not unwholesome, by way of root condition. Under root [condition] there is one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there is one.

Dependent on a rootless, rootless, indeterminate state, there arises a state that is neither root nor rootless and is not indeterminate, by way of root condition. Under root [condition] there is one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance there is one.
The Section on Reasons is finished.
